controlStrategies.description: Users in the role \"Human\" are trained to avoid most common cyber security errors by using only strong passwords, recognising malicious emails, and the importance of physical security including the use of screen locking for fixed devices that cannot be carried on the person.

controls.label: SecurityTraining
controls.description: The human has undergone security training, going beyond basic password and device security and covering aspects such as malicious email threats, and physical security of mobile and fixed host devices.

controlStrategies.description: Device \"Patients_Phone\" is a personal device dedicated to one user, who will protect it from some types of attacks involving physical access. This particular strategy relates to threats that are blocked, affording slightly less than perfect protection because the user may be overcome by force or become temporarily less than vigilant.

controls.label: PersonalDevice
controls.description: The host is a personal device, carried by and therefore monitored and protected by its only user.
